title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: Now let's talk about what functions or methods are in Java.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: Functions are a block of code in Java.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: What is a block of code?

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: It is a code that takes some input,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: operates some input,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: and produces some output.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: For example, if we take a thermometer instead of a block of code,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: the work of a thermometer is to sense the temperature from your body

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: and it shows the output according to the temperature.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: Similarly, if we take the example of a volume button on our phone,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: it takes an input from our thumb or finger

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: and it produces an output that the volume in our phone is increasing.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: Similarly, if we take the example of a TV remote,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: there are many buttons in that TV remote.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: Every button is performing a task in itself.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: This task is an operation that the button is performing.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: We press the button in the input and it gives us a result in the output.

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: The result is that the TV channel is on the serial or Discovery channel.

text: In this way, functions are a block of code,

text: Stack means, if you have kept books at home during the preparation of JEE or during the board exams,

text: Now, whenever functions are in memory, they are saved in the form of a stack.

text: So, here some part of the memory will be allocated to our main function.

text: And as soon as the call is made to this new function in the main function,

title: 7_Functions_Methods_Java_
text: then another stack frame will be made.
